tyler_sales: Quick sync — OmegaHealth wants a Private POC (VPC) next week. Requirements: BYOK with HSM import, client cert auth for model endpoints, no internet egress, and we need a short window (2 weeks). Can eng/security confirm what we need to hand them for creds + timeline? cc @maria_sec @jin_eng :raised_hands:
jin_eng: We can stand up Private with a single dedicated pool. For HSM BYOK we support two flows: key-import (PKCS#12) or KMS-wrapped external key material. Which do they prefer? For certs we'll need CSR(s) from their CA + orgName and SANs for internal endpoints. Also need their VPC CIDR/IPs for SGs.
maria_sec: Security needs: HSM attestation report (for import) or KMIP logs. Are they requiring FIPS 140-2/3 validation? Also need to confirm rotation policy (we recommend <90d). Send back our MSA and the encryption key handling addendum. Also, we require an ARO for any customer-managed keys during POC.
sam_k: Pricing note: For a 2-week POC we can offer trial dedicated pool credits (up to 200 GPU-hours) + temporary enterprise API keys. If they want persistent dedicated capacity after POC that's quoted as reserved monthly. Quick numbers: trial = no charge up to threshold; reserved 8xA100-equivalent pool ≈ $X/month (details by contract). I'll DM finance for exact quote.
jin_eng: Examples: for CSR generation we ask for a subject like:
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----
CN=omegahealth-poc, O=OmegaHealth, OU=Engineering, emailAddress=infra@omegahealth.com
SAN=internal.omegahealth.poc, 10.0.12.0/24
-----END CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----
We also accept signed cert chain if they have an internal CA. For key import we prefer wrapped key via AES-KW with RSA-OAEP for transport. Example command to export wrapped key:
openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -inform PEM -outform DER -v1 PBE-SHA1-3DES -in key.pem -out key.p8
(we can provide a small script if needed)
alex_platform: On our side we'll need:
- a signed cert for the service endpoint (PEM chain)
- public key thumbprint (SHA256)
- their CIDR(s) and an SSH jump host user for debugging
- the CSR CN/SANs as jin said
I can provide an Ansible role to push certs once we have them:
---
- name: install cert
  copy:
    src: "{{ cert_file }}"
    dest: /etc/redwood/certs/omega.pem
    mode: '0644'
---
maria_sec: Also: please confirm whether logs need to be exported to their SIEM (we support syslog/CEF). If they insist on HSM in customer's datacenter, we'd need a different engagement (on-prem package + longer lead time).
tyler_sales: Great — can we get a checklist to send to the customer? Also, timeline: they want to cutover to POC staging Mon 3/25. Are we good to collect CSR and wrapped key by EOD Thu 3/21?
sam_k: I'll assemble the checklist + pricing blurb and share a one-pager. finance says we can firm numbers after SOW.
jin_eng: I'll spin up the private pool template and a small terraform snippet for network peering. Also creating a short runbook for key import flow. Will drop links here shortly.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: provisioning-private-pool-omegahealth started (job id: prov-99321). ETA ~6h.
tyler_sales: Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll email OmegaHealth and request CSR + attest report, and copy this checklist. :thumbsup:
